title: Technical Assistance
text:
Skip to main content
The IMF Technical Assistance Dataset records the IMF’s technical assistance to member countries in 1964–1989: 2,511 short-term missions and 1,215 resident advisor assignments in 161 countries. It is compiled from IMF archival documents: annual technical assistance reports issued as Executive Board documents, and Secretary’s Circulars listing staff assignments. For each mission, it records the country, purpose, IMF department, staff, dates, and source document. A country-year panel counts missions and mission-months, overall and by department. The dataset will be released once the working paper that introduces it is published.

title: Governance
text:
Skip to main content
The IMF Executive Board Minutes Dataset is a text corpus of the IMF Executive Board’s discussions of individual countries in 1995–2015. It covers 3,111 meetings on 142 low- and middle-income countries, mostly on lending and economic surveillance, with more than 38 million words of comments from Board members. For each meeting, it identifies everyone who attended and gives the full text of each comment from the Board’s minutes, with the speaker’s position, country, and constituency, and whether the comment was a written statement. The codebook explains how the Executive Board works and defines each variable.

title: Conditionality
text:
Skip to main content
The IMF Conditionality Dataset records the policy conditions attached to IMF lending programs in 1980–2019: 65,894 conditions in 134 countries. They are taken from the Letters of Intent and Memoranda of Economic and Financial Policies that borrowing governments draft with IMF staff, found in IMF Executive Board documents and Country Reports. Each condition is classified by type, from prior actions to structural benchmarks, and into one of 13 policy areas. The main dataset gives yearly indicators for 220 countries and territories; the raw dataset lists each condition. The codebook explains how the data were collected, coded, and combined.

title: Programs
text:
Skip to main content
The IMF Programs Dataset records participation in IMF lending programs in 1952–2025. The raw dataset lists 1,693 arrangements and outright purchases for 162 IMF members, with their facilities, dates, and amounts. Most come from the IMF’s History of Lending Commitments page; the other 102 come from IMF press releases, Executive Board documents, and other IMF publications. The panel dataset turns 1,428 of these arrangements into yearly indicators for 202 independent states: months under a program, and whether one was in force, for all, concessional, and non-concessional programs. The codebook explains how the data were collected and built.

title: Programs
text:
Version history

October 2026
Replaces the hand-coded June 2020 file with a dataset built by two R scripts from the IMF’s History of Lending Commitments page, with 102 arrangements and outright purchases that the page does not show added from other IMF sources. Coverage extends from 1980–2019 to 1952–2025, and a new panel dataset gives yearly program participation indicators for every independent state. The dataset has its own codebook. The indicators have the same names as the 21 in the March 2026 Conditionality release, but are built from the new data and count months differently: a program in force from March to September of one year now counts as seven months, not six.
Current release: its files are under Downloads.


June 2020
Coded by hand from IMF documents: 1,284 arrangements in 144 countries, approved from April 1978 to December 2019. It was offered with the March 2026 Conditionality release, whose codebook lists its variables.




Programs dataset (v2020-06_IMFMonitor_Programs.xlsx)
One row per arrangement, with its type, approval date, duration, amount, augmentations, expiration date, and source documents. The March 2026 Conditionality code reads it under its original name, IMFMonitor_Programs.xlsx.
